## Amend Contract (AC)

Single writer for creating a numbered Amendment against a SIGNED contract (before signature, just edit the draft). Allocates the number by realm query (max existing + 1) so two drafts can never both claim No. 2. The amendment starts as a draft — it travels the same review-and-execute road as any contract paper.

### Example

Natural target: the linked MSA — Northwind, which already carries Amendment No. 1.

### Non-goals

Does not enact the change on the Contract card — commercial effect is a human edit plus re-execution.
